anomalies.observed: R34 is specified as 120k in the netlist, while its MPN field is 0603WAF1200T5E (120Ω) and the matching CAN1 termination resistor R35 is 120R.
anomalies.expected: R34 should be 120Ω to provide standard CAN bus termination on CAN0, matching R35 on CAN1.

evidence.quote: R34 | 120k | Resistor_SMD:R_0603_1608Metric | MotorController:TAYLOR_RESISTOR |  | LCSC=C22787, MPN=0603WAF1200T5E, Manufacturer=UNI-ROYAL(Uniroyal Elec)
R35 | 120R | Resistor_SMD:R_0603_1608Metric | MotorController:TAYLOR_RESISTOR |  | LCSC=C22787, MPN=0603WAF1200T5E, Manufacturer=UNI-ROYAL(Uniroyal Elec)

anomalies.impact: If assembled to the 120k value, CAN0 termination is effectively absent, causing reflections and unreliable CAN communication; if assembled to the MPN, the value field is misleading.

anomalies.observed: U10 pin 4 (GND1) and pin 5 (GND2) are both on net GND; U11 pin 4 (GND1) and pin 5 (GND2) are also both on net GND.
anomalies.expected: For isolated CAN transceivers, GND1 (logic side) and GND2 (isolated bus side) must be on separate nets to maintain galvanic isolation.

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U10.4(GND1,power_in) U10.5(GND2,power_in) ... U11.4(GND1,power_in) U11.5(GND2,power_in) ...
two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9) through an isolated CAN transceiver (U11/companion)

anomalies.impact: The isolation barrier is bypassed, so ground loops and common-mode noise can couple between the CM4 and the CAN bus, defeating the intended isolation and potentially causing communication errors or damage.

anomalies.observed: D30 pin 4 (A2) is on ESTOP_OUT, and R60 pin 2 is also on ESTOP_OUT; R60 pin 1 connects to D30 pin 2 (K2). Thus the series combination of LED2 and R60 is connected between ESTOP_OUT and ESTOP_OUT.
anomalies.expected: The ESTOP_OUT indicator LED should be connected between ESTOP_OUT and GND (e.g., R60.2 to GND) so it can light when ESTOP_OUT is high.
anomalies.impact: The ESTOP_OUT indicator LED never lights, so the board loses visual indication of the e-stop output state.

parsed.summary: The design files contain three anomalies: R34 is incorrectly valued at 120k instead of 120Ω for CAN0 termination, the isolated CAN transceivers U10/U11 have their isolated and logic grounds tied together, and the ESTOP_OUT indicator LED D30 is wired in a loop so it can never light.
